title: The Fisherman: Bobby Fischer (Stockfish waited for one man)
post: Stockfish waited for one man to die 🎣 #chess #bobbyfischer #stockfish #story

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: This fish is the strongest chess player on Earth. But it was afraid of one man.
phrases.say: [serious] This fish... is the strongest chess player on Earth. [pause] But it was afraid of one man.

phrases.text: It has won the top engine championship nineteen times.
phrases.say: It has won the top engine championship... nineteen times.

phrases.text: It gave Hikaru a free pawn, and still beat him.
phrases.say: It gave Hikaru a free pawn... [smug] and still beat him.

phrases.text: And still, it hid until that man was dead.
phrases.say: And still, it hid... [serious] until that man was dead.

phrases.text: Bobby Fischer. In German, Fischer means fisherman.
phrases.say: Bobby Fischer. [pause] In German, Fischer means... [intense] fisherman.

phrases.text: While he was alive, no big fish was safe.
phrases.say: While he was alive... no big fish was safe.

phrases.text: Then the Soviets. He beat the world's best twenty times in a row.
phrases.say: Then... the Soviets. [intense] He beat the world's best twenty times in a row.

phrases.text: Taimanov: 6–0. His own country took his salary. Larsen: 6–0.
phrases.say: Taimanov: six, zero. His own country took his salary. [pause] Larsen: six, zero.

phrases.text: World champion Spassky. After game six, even he applauded.
phrases.say: World champion Spassky. After game six... [awed] even he applauded.

phrases.text: In 1977, he played a computer. Three games, three wins.
phrases.say: In nineteen seventy-seven, he played a computer. [smug] Three games... three wins.

phrases.text: Near the end, someone asked him about chess.
phrases.say: [softly] Near the end... someone asked him about chess.
[whispers] No... [pause] I hate chess. [pause] Very much.
[softly] He died in January, two thousand eight.

phrases.text: That same year, the fish finally dared to surface.
phrases.say: That same year... [whispers] the fish finally dared to surface.
Stockfish: thirty-six fifty. Fischer: twenty-seven eighty-five. What's yours?
